q1_issues.issue: A scalar-change subject takes Theme, not Patient (the instruction set's own 'the temperature fell' example uses Theme).
The end value is encoded as a spatial (Goal sk_inch_up_1 sk_level_2), which the scalar-change rule explicitly forbids — an endpoint belongs on MeasureTo.
The start value 'from April's 6 percent' is encoded as a spatial Source onto an invented entity instead of (MeasureFrom <event> <scale> 6 percent).
The delta 'one-tenth of a percentage point' is encoded as a comparative MoreBy between two reified levels instead of (MeasureBy <event> <scale> 0.1 percentage_point).
(Most high sk_level_2 level) drops 'since July 1994', widening the claim to an all-time high that the sentence does not state.
sk_level_1 and sk_level_2 (with 9) are invented referents — no 'level' noun occurs in the sentence, so neither type atom is readable off the words.

q2_gaps: a scalar-change endpoint stated as a superlative description rather than a figure ('to its highest') — MeasureTo cannot carry it without a magnitude and unit
a superlative restricted by a temporal window ('the highest since July 1994') — Most / AmongMost have no slot for the comparison window
a start value carrying its own time reference ('from April's 6 percent') — MeasureFrom has no time slot
notes: Only the rate typing plus genus, the inch_up phrasal-verb symbol and the Past atom survive scrutiny; the whole from/to/delta core is routed through motion obliques and a comparative over invented 'level' entities rather than the Scalar-change heads MeasureFrom / MeasureTo / MeasureBy.
